QueryString.value: WITH flow AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, coalesce(Repository, '') AS Repository, concat(toString(PullRequestId), ':', toString(WorkItemId)) AS Resource, '' AS Pipeline, '' AS Step, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(SysProperties_EnqueueTime)) / 1000 AS ObservedAt, toString(PullRequestId) AS PullRequestId, toString(WorkItemId) AS WorkItemId, coalesce(WorkItemType, '') AS WorkItemType, coalesce(State, '') AS State, coalesce(AreaPath, '') AS AreaPath, coalesce(IterationPath, '') AS IterationPath, coalesce(Team, '') AS Team, coalesce(Sprint, '') AS Sprint, coalesce(TargetBranch, '') AS TargetBranch, coalesce(TargetPackageVersion, '') AS TargetPackageVersion, coalesce(InitialIterationPath, '') AS InitialIterationPath, coalesce(Resolver, '') AS Resolver, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(PullRequestCreated)) / 1000 AS Created, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(PullRequestMerged)) / 1000 AS Merged, toFloat64(VersionMismatch) AS VersionMismatch, toFloat64(DoneWithoutVersion) AS DoneWithoutVersion, toFloat64(HistoryAvailable) AS HistoryAvailable, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Activated)) / 1000 AS Activated, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Resolved)) / 1000 AS Resolved, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(StateChanged)) / 1000 AS StateChanged, toFloat64(ActiveToResolvedSeconds) AS ActiveToResolved, toFloat64(MergeToResolvedSeconds) AS MergeToResolved, toFloat64(IterationChanges) AS IterationChanges, toFloat64(CarriedOver) AS CarriedOver, toFloat64(MergedNotDone) AS MergedNotDone, toFloat64(StoryPoints) AS StoryPoints, if(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY Organization, Project, WorkItemId ORDER BY PullRequestId) = 1, toFloat64(StoryPoints), NULL) AS StoryPointsCounted FROM ADOTelemetry_WorkItemFlow FINAL ), prs AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, coalesce(Repository, '') AS Repository, toString(PullRequestId) AS PullRequestId, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(FirstReview)) / 1000 AS FirstReview, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(FirstApproval)) / 1000 AS FirstApproval, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(LastApproval)) / 1000 AS LastApproval, toFloat64(TimeToFirstApprovalSeconds) AS TimeToFirstApproval, toFloat64(ApprovalToMergeSeconds) AS ApprovalToMerge FROM ADOTelemetry_PullRequest FINAL ), sprints AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, IterationPath, coalesce(Team, '') AS Team, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Start)) / 1000 AS Start, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Finish)) / 1000 AS Finish FROM ADOTelemetry_Sprint FINAL ), calendars AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, Team, groupArray(tuple(IterationPath, Start, Finish)) AS Windows FROM sprints WHERE Start IS NOT NULL AND Finish IS NOT NULL AND Team != '' GROUP BY Organization, Project, Team ), joined AS ( SELECT flow.Organization AS Organization, flow.Project AS Project, flow.Repository AS Repository, flow.Resource AS Resource, flow.Pipeline AS Pipeline, flow.Step AS Step, flow.ObservedAt AS ObservedAt, flow.PullRequestId AS PullRequestId, flow.WorkItemId AS WorkItemId, flow.WorkItemType AS WorkItemType, flow.State AS State, flow.AreaPath AS AreaPath, flow.IterationPath AS IterationPath, flow.Team AS Team, flow.Sprint AS Sprint, flow.TargetBranch AS TargetBranch, flow.TargetPackageVersion AS TargetPackageVersion, flow.InitialIterationPath AS InitialIterationPath, flow.Resolver AS Resolver, flow.Created AS Created, flow.Merged AS Merged, flow.VersionMismatch AS VersionMismatch, flow.DoneWithoutVersion AS DoneWithoutVersion, flow.HistoryAvailable AS HistoryAvailable, flow.Activated AS Activated, flow.Resolved AS Resolved, flow.StateChanged AS StateChanged, flow.ActiveToResolved AS ActiveToResolved, flow.MergeToResolved AS MergeToResolved, flow.IterationChanges AS IterationChanges, flow.CarriedOver AS CarriedOver, flow.MergedNotDone AS MergedNotDone, flow.StoryPoints AS StoryPoints, flow.StoryPointsCounted AS StoryPointsCounted, prs.FirstReview AS FirstReview, prs.FirstApproval AS FirstApproval, prs.LastApproval AS LastApproval, prs.TimeToFirstApproval AS TimeToFirstApproval, prs.ApprovalToMerge AS ApprovalToMerge, arrayFirst(window -> ifNull(flow.Created >= window.2 AND flow.Created < window.3, 0), calendars.Windows).1 AS CreatedSprintPath, arrayFirst(window -> ifNull(flow.Merged >= window.2 AND flow.Merged < window.3, 0), calendars.Windows).1 AS MergedSprintPath, arrayFirst(window -> ifNull(flow.Merged >= window.2 AND flow.Merged < window.3, 0), calendars.Windows).3 AS MergedSprintFinish FROM flow LEFT JOIN prs ON flow.Organization = prs.Organization AND flow.Project = prs.Project AND flow.Repository = prs.Repository AND flow.PullRequestId = prs.PullRequestId LEFT JOIN calendars ON flow.Organization = calendars.Organization AND flow.Project = calendars.Project AND flow.Team = calendars.Team ) SELECT * EXCEPT (StoryPoints, StoryPointsCounted), if(CreatedSprintPath = '' OR MergedSprintPath = '', NULL, toNullable(toFloat64(CreatedSprintPath != MergedSprintPath))) AS CrossedSprintBoundary, if(MergedSprintPath = '', NULL, toNullable(toFloat64(Merged >= MergedSprintFinish - 172800))) AS MergedInLastTwoDays, StoryPoints, StoryPointsCounted FROM joined
